original_value: Western Digital My Passport portable storage perfectly complements your on-the-go lifestyle. Designed to fit in the palm of your hand, there is plenty of space to store a massive number of photos, videos, music and documents.

result.paraphrase: Western Digital My Passport portable storage is a compact companion for life on the move. Small enough to rest in the palm of your hand, it offers ample room for a huge collection of photos, videos, music, and documents.
